answer: Sybil resistance can come from a burned maintenance tax, not deposits. Each identity pays an upkeep fee priced against total supply: fee = 0.25 coin x ceil(N/512), N = live identities, burned, never refunded. Validators drop any message lacking the current-epoch tax receipt, so unpaid identities earn nothing. Receipts are signed over (key, birth epoch), blocking resets via rekeying. Splitting one persona into n copies pays n fees, and each copy raises N, so per-copy cost grows linearly with n. An ocean relay island pays little; ivory-tower fake farms pay superlinearly.
